directive_section: the R416 root-cause fix (the operator's screenshot)

the_defect.symptom: a run whose SYNTHESIZE stage failed (mechanism GENERATION failed — transport or no-coherent-mechanism) terminated final_status=REJECTED, and the product surface then told the user: 'The run finished and the engine REJECTED the candidate — the adversarial chain found the idea not defensible enough to package.'
the_defect.why_it_was_a_lie: the adversarial chain never ran and no candidate ever existed — the stage tracker itself showed Stress-testing NOT_STARTED. The user was told a verdict was reached when the machine had failed to GENERATE. This is exactly the Art. LXI contamination (implementation failure converted into a scientific rejection), laundered through the wording layer.
the_defect.measured_reproduction: the sealed fixture in tests/test_r416_evolution.py (TestHonestFinalStatus): a SYNTHESIZE transport failure now terminates MECHANISM_GENERATION_FAILED with a reason that names the generation gap — never REJECTED, never an adversarial claim

the_fix.engine: SYNTHESIZE failure -> final_status=MECHANISM_GENERATION_FAILED (typed; the reason carries the actual stage failure). The downstream evolution pipeline (R416 Phase C) then produces the mandatory baseline architecture so a valid query still ends with an invention.
the_fix.product_surface: user_state/run_state translate the typed statuses honestly: MECHANISM_GENERATION_FAILED -> 'the engine could not generate an architecture (transport-class) — not a scientific rejection; retry resumable'. REJECTED (an ADJUDICATED kill) -> the invention is presented as IN DEVELOPMENT with the generation record and diagnosed cause — never the banned dead-end sentence.
the_fix.nothing_weakened: the adversarial chain still kills candidates the same way (the live acceptance run shows a real 5-dimension KILL recorded to the cemetery); only the ATTRIBUTION became honest (Art. XV: the reporting layer was the defect, the gates were not)

constitutional_basis: Art. LXI: infrastructure failure is never scientific rejection
Art. XV: the coder must never optimize the reporting layer to make the system look healthier
Art. XXV: unknown must remain unknown — a generation gap is stated as a generation gap
